subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw ship this first-party MXC plugin while @microsoft/mxc-sdk 0.7.0 exposes the full base64 container request on the wxc-exec process command line?
rationale: The patch can document and minimize local handling, but code review cannot decide whether the upstream host process-inspection exposure and preview native dependency graph meet OpenClaw's security bar.

options.title: Wait for safer transport
options.body: Pause landing until the upstream MXC SDK provides a non-argv request transport, avoiding exposure of policy and environment data through process inspection.

options.title: Accept preview boundary
options.body: Approve the exact dependency graph and ship the prerelease plugin with the argv limitation prominently documented and tracked upstream.

recommendation.title: Wait for safer transport
recommendation.body: Pause landing until the upstream MXC SDK provides a non-argv request transport, avoiding exposure of policy and environment data through process inspection.

likelyOwner.reason: The live PR is assigned to this repository owner, who can coordinate the required security/admin approval and final product acceptance.
